Analytical Protocol - Inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy: (Concentrations of trace metals (Cd, Cr, Cu, Mn, Ni, Pb and Zn) were determined using inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectrometer (ICP-AES, Perkin Elmer Optima 3300RL). Accuracy regularly checked by including standard reference material (dogfish muscle, DORM-2, from National Research Council, Canada) within batches. Agreement considered good, within 14%)
limitations: ICP-OES is generally appropriate for copper in biota at a contaminated site, but lack of LOD/LOQ information makes full confidence difficult.
